_comment: Not a standalone package.json — electron/build.sh merges this with the root package.json's `dependencies` at build time, so runtime dependency versions stay in sync with the plain Node/NSIS build automatically rather than being duplicated by hand. Deliberately has no devDependencies (electron/electron-builder) — those are installed separately in electron/.tooling/ so they never end up in this project's node_modules, which gets shipped verbatim (see build.sh for why).
name: scribe-local-desktop
description: Scribe Local — self-hosted tutorial builder (desktop app)
